description: Choose a policy, report addresses and alignment and get a DMARC record with every tag explained, compared with the one you publish now. Inputs – domain: Domain; p: Policy (p); sp: Subdomain policy (sp); rua: Aggregate reports to (rua); ruf: Failure reports to (ruf, optional); adkim: DKIM alignment (adkim); aspf: SPF alignment (aspf); t: Test mode (t); pct: pct (legacy, optional). Results include plain-English findings with fixes and a shareable link.
name: dmarc_builder
title: DMARC record builder
